title: PCB Pro Professional Syllabus 2026–2027
description: Syllabus overlay untuk menjembatani Software Engineer ke PCB/Hardware Engineering: teori → ECAD → constraints → manufacturing → lab validation → automation. Disusun dari kurikulum/kompetensi resmi dan kebutuhan pekerjaan terkini; bukan pengganti akreditasi atau sertifikasi resmi.
evidencePolicy: Materi membedakan teori, design rule, vendor capability, simulation, manufacturing check, dan physical measurement. Nilai spesifik yang bergantung vendor/MPN tidak boleh diasumsikan.

sources.title: ABET Criteria for Accrediting Engineering Programs 2026–2027
sources.use: Problem solving, engineering design, experimentation, communication, teamwork, modern tools, electrical/computer engineering breadth+depth.

sources.title: IPC PCB Design Curriculum
sources.use: Schematic capture, library parts, PCB Design I/II, multilayer routing, SI, transmission lines, manufacturing/assembly, DFM.

sources.title: IPC CID/CID+ Designer Certification
sources.use: Transform electrical circuit description into PCB design that can be manufactured, assembled, tested; materials, component/assembly/fabrication/documentation considerations.

sources.title: IPC PCB Designer Engineer Apprenticeship
sources.use: 158-hour pathway: Design I, DFM intro, Design II, DFM, advanced specialization, CID.

sources.title: KiCad 9 PCB Editor routing documentation
sources.use: Interactive router, single-track automatic finish, rule-aware manual flow.

sources.title: EasyEDA Pro Auto Routing
sources.use: Autoroute scope/settings, route layers, design-rule usage, iterations/preview/apply, external DSN/SES workflow.

sources.title: Apple Hardware PCB Layout Engineer — Sep 2026
sources.use: PCB layout, SI/PI, HDI, BGA fan-out, impedance stackups, blind/buried vias, manufacturing/assembly, constraints, collaboration.

sources.title: Apple Signal and Power Integrity Engineer — Oct 2026
sources.use: High-speed/low-speed interfaces, PCB stackup, placement/routing, PDN, decoupling, transient/frequency analysis, EMI, debug and validation.

sources.title: Apple iPad Hardware Systems Design Engineer — 2026
sources.use: Concept-to-production, simulation, bring-up, debug, lab instruments, rigid/flex PCB, interfaces, scripting and automation.

branches.title: P1. Engineering Foundation → Hardware Practice
branches.summary: Fondasi yang wajib supaya software engineer tidak cuma hafal tombol EDA: problem formulation, circuit reasoning, measurement, standards, documentation, dan safety.

topics.title: Requirements → Engineering Constraints
topics.summary: Ubah kebutuhan produk menjadi constraint terukur: supply, current, interfaces, dimensions, environment, cost, reliability, testability.
topics.intuition: PCB bagus dimulai sebelum routing. Requirement yang kabur menghasilkan rules dan layout yang salah.
design: Setiap UNKNOWN punya owner dan cara verifikasi.
limitations: Tool EDA tidak bisa menebak requirement bisnis/safety yang tidak diberikan.
practice: Tulis requirement board sensor 5 V → 3.3 V dengan I2C dan ukuran maksimum.
Bedakan constraint produk, constraint fabricator, dan preference designer.

topics.title: Measurement, Lab Safety & Correlation
topics.summary: Gunakan DMM, oscilloscope, current probe, logic analyzer, spectrum analyzer/VNA sesuai kebutuhan dan korelasikan simulation dengan hardware.
topics.intuition: Simulation adalah model; produk nyata harus dikonfirmasi oleh pengukuran dengan setup probe yang benar.
design: Dokumentasikan test point dan ground access.
Simpan expected vs measured vs tolerance.
limitations: Measurement salah setup bisa lebih menyesatkan daripada simulation.
practice: Rancang test plan untuk rail 3.3 V startup.
Jelaskan kenapa probe ground panjang bisa membuat ringing palsu.

topics.title: Standards, Documentation & Technical Communication
topics.summary: Belajar membaca standar, datasheet, fab capability, assembly notes, drawing, release package dan engineering change.
topics.intuition: Di pekerjaan, desain harus bisa diproduksi, direview, ditest, dan diwariskan ke engineer lain.
limitations: PCB Pro tidak boleh menyatakan compliance ke standar yang belum benar-benar diimplementasikan/diuji.
practice: Buat release checklist sederhana.
Tulis manufacturing note tanpa ambigu.

branches.title: P2. Schematic, Library & Component Data
branches.summary: Dari electrical intent sampai reusable device data: symbol, pin, footprint, MPN, datasheet, ERC, power tree dan interface.

topics.title: Schematic Architecture & Net Intent
topics.summary: Bangun schematic yang menunjukkan power domains, signal flow, interfaces, protection, debug, programming dan test points.
topics.intuition: Schematic adalah source-of-intent; layout seharusnya tidak menebak koneksi.
limitations: Auto-connect tidak boleh membuat electrical intent yang tidak pernah didefinisikan.
practice: Pecah board MCU menjadi power/input/MCU/output/debug blocks.
Buat checklist schematic review.

topics.title: Device = Symbol + Footprint + Data + 3D
topics.summary: Kelola device sebagai satu paket data dengan pin mapping, footprint, MPN/vendor, lifecycle dan evidence.
topics.intuition: Kesalahan pin mapping/footprint bisa membuat board gagal walau schematic logic benar.
design: Exact ratings hanya dari exact MPN/vendor.
limitations: Generic template tidak cukup untuk rating kritis atau manufacturing release.
practice: Audit satu IC: symbol ↔ datasheet ↔ footprint ↔ pin 1 marker.
Bedakan package name vs manufacturer land pattern.

topics.title: ERC & Schematic Review
topics.summary: Cari duplicate references, floating pins, missing ground/reference, missing footprints, invalid power connections dan intent mismatch.
topics.intuition: ERC menyaring kesalahan struktural sebelum biaya layout meningkat.
design: Setiap warning harus disposition: fix / intentional / unsupported check.
limitations: ERC clean tidak membuktikan analog performance atau datasheet compliance.
practice: Klasifikasikan 10 contoh warning ERC.
Tentukan mana yang benar-benar blocker.

branches.title: P3. Board Stackup, Placement & Constraint Setup
branches.summary: Fondasi fisik PCB: board outline, layer stack, return path, impedance context, placement zones dan constraint classes.

topics.title: Layer Stackup & Reference Planes
topics.summary: Pilih jumlah layer, copper/plane arrangement, dielectric, thickness dan reference plane berdasarkan routing, EMC, impedance, power dan cost.
topics.intuition: Layer count bukan sekadar ruang routing; stackup menentukan return path dan coupling.
formulas: Microstrip/stripline impedance requires geometry + dielectric model; use validated solver/fabricator stackup.
design: Jangan putus return path critical signal.
limitations: PCB Pro current manufacturing release belum boleh mengarang dielectric/Dk atau impedance tanpa data.
practice: Bandingkan 2-layer vs 4-layer untuk MCU + USB.
Tentukan return plane setiap high-speed layer.

topics.title: Placement by Function, Flow & Return Current
topics.summary: Tempatkan connector, power, clocks, IC, decoupling, protection dan noisy/quiet blocks berdasarkan signal/power flow dan mechanical constraints.
topics.intuition: Routing yang sulit sering merupakan gejala placement yang buruk.
design: Decoupling dekat power pin dengan loop kecil.
Pisahkan noisy power switching dari sensitive analog/RF.
limitations: Auto-layout harus direview; connectivity saja tidak cukup untuk analog/RF/thermal intent.
practice: Susun placement order untuk board MCU + buck + sensor.
Cari tiga alasan component tidak boleh ditempatkan hanya berdasarkan shortest wire.

topics.title: Constraint Classes & Rule Strategy
topics.summary: Definisikan clearance, width, via, differential pair, length/skew, edge, keepout dan class per net.
topics.intuition: Router profesional tidak hanya mencari jalan; ia mencari jalan yang memenuhi constraint.
design: Pisahkan default rules dari critical-net overrides.
Trace setiap rule ke alasan: fab/current/impedance/safety.
limitations: Rule angka tanpa fabricator/material/current/voltage context bisa salah.
practice: Buat rule table untuk power, GPIO, I2C, USB differential.
Tentukan rule yang harus blocking vs warning.

branches.title: P4. Routing, Autorouting & Multilayer Strategy
branches.summary: Interactive routing, obstacle handling, layer transitions, vias, differential routing, tuning dan bagaimana menilai autorouter secara profesional.

topics.title: Interactive Routing: Push / Walk-around / Shove Thinking
topics.summary: Route berdasarkan net intent, return path, clearance, current, coupling dan manufacturability—bukan sekadar garis terpendek.
topics.intuition: Manual routing tetap penting untuk critical nets dan untuk menilai hasil otomatis.
limitations: Canvas connectivity tidak otomatis menjamin signal integrity.
practice: Route power + clock + bus dengan prioritas berbeda.
Jelaskan kapan via lebih buruk daripada detour.

topics.title: Autorouter: Preview, Cost, Layers & Human Review
topics.summary: Gunakan autorouter sebagai optimizer constrained: scope nets, layers, existing tracks, priorities, rules, iterations, preview/apply lalu DRC/manual cleanup.
topics.intuition: Autorouter yang baik mengurangi kerja repetitif; ia tidak menghilangkan engineering judgment.
design: Jangan auto-route critical nets tanpa constraint.
limitations: PCB Pro v1.23 autorouter maksimum 2 layer, 90°, layer-per-connection; belum mid-route via switching/inner-layer production model.
practice: Bandingkan speed vs completion strategy.
Jelaskan mengapa completion 100% belum berarti layout bagus.

topics.title: Differential Pairs, Length & Skew
topics.summary: Kelola pair membership, spacing, reference plane, skew, uncoupled length, via symmetry dan receiver/transmitter constraints.
topics.intuition: Dua trace bukan otomatis differential pair yang baik; field coupling + return path menentukan behavior.
limitations: Exact impedance requires stackup/material + field solver/fabricator data.
practice: Buat review checklist USB/PCIe-style differential routing.
Bedakan length matching dan impedance control.

branches.title: P5. Signal Integrity, Power Integrity & EMC
branches.summary: Skill yang muncul langsung di role 2026: transmission lines, high-speed links, PDN, decoupling, EMI/crosstalk dan simulation-to-lab correlation.

topics.title: Transmission Lines & Return Paths
topics.summary: Saat interconnect electrical length signifikan, trace harus dipandang sebagai transmission line dengan impedance, delay, reflection dan return current.
topics.intuition: High-speed ditentukan edge rate, bukan hanya clock frequency.
limitations: Rule-of-thumb tidak menggantikan channel model untuk sign-off.
practice: Tentukan kapan trace perlu transmission-line treatment.
Analisis dampak split plane di bawah high-speed trace.

topics.title: High-Speed & Low-Speed Interface Layout
topics.summary: Review interface seperti USB/PCIe/DisplayPort/MIPI/DDR serta I2C/SPI/JTAG/I2S berdasarkan spec, topology, length/skew, connector dan return path.
topics.intuition: Setiap interface punya electrical budget dan topology berbeda.
design: Trace constraints berasal dari interface spec + silicon/vendor guidance.
limitations: PCB Pro tidak boleh membuat pass/fail protocol compliance tanpa spec/model/test yang relevan.
practice: Buat constraint checklist satu high-speed interface.
Bandingkan point-to-point vs multi-drop.

topics.title: Power Delivery Network & Decoupling
topics.summary: Rancang regulator-to-load path, planes, vias, bulk/local decoupling dan target impedance untuk transient current.
topics.intuition: Supply rail adalah jaringan frekuensi-dependent, bukan ideal DC wire.
formulas: Target impedance approximation Ztarget = ΔVallowed / ΔIstep
design: Use plane/via geometry to reduce loop inductance.
limitations: Cap ESR/ESL and package/plane parasitics require exact models for quantitative prediction.
practice: Estimate target impedance from droop budget.
Design measurement plan for rail transient.

topics.title: EMI, Crosstalk & Noise Immunity
topics.summary: Minimalkan unintended coupling melalui placement, return paths, spacing, filtering, shielding strategy dan edge control.
topics.intuition: EMI adalah system problem: source-path-victim.
design: Fix current-return geometry before adding random filtering.
limitations: EMC compliance requires defined standard/test setup and physical testing.
practice: Trace source-path-victim pada kasus noise.
Review connector entry for ESD/EMI.

branches.title: P6. DFM, Assembly, CAM & Supplier Handoff
branches.summary: Dari design rules menjadi board yang benar-benar bisa difabrikasi, dirakit, diperiksa dan diproduksi konsisten.

topics.title: PCB DFM & Fabricator Capability
topics.summary: Cocokkan width/spacing, drill, annular ring, copper-edge, solder mask, board thickness, finish, stackup dan tolerances ke capability fabricator.
topics.intuition: CAD-valid belum tentu manufacturable atau economical.
design: Gunakan capability table vendor sebagai input rule.
limitations: Capability berubah antar vendor/process; jangan hardcode sebagai universal truth.
practice: Audit design terhadap fab capability sheet.
Klasifikasikan blocker/cost-adder/preference.

topics.title: PCBA / DFA / Stencil / Assembly Reality
topics.summary: Pertimbangkan component spacing, orientation, fiducial, stencil/paste, reflow, hand-solder/rework, inspection, connector/mechanical access.
topics.intuition: Board bukan selesai saat Gerber jadi; assembly process menentukan yield dan reliability.
limitations: Assembly rules bergantung CM/process/package.
practice: Buat DFA review checklist.
Cari risiko assembly pada dense connector + tall components.

topics.title: Gerber/Drill/BOM/CPL Release Discipline
topics.summary: Generate file dari source-of-truth, jalankan preflight, review CAM, checksum, revision, notes dan archive.
topics.intuition: Release engineering mencegah file lama/parsial masuk produksi.
design: Satu revision menghasilkan satu immutable release package.
Jangan mix file dari revision berbeda.
limitations: PCB Pro output tanpa verified pad-stack coverage harus tetap Engineering Draft.
practice: Susun manufacturing release checklist.
Jelaskan fungsi checksum dan manifest.

topics.title: Troubleshooting & Defect Analysis
topics.summary: Hubungkan defect assembly/fabrication dengan symptom electrical dan root cause: solder bridge/open, tombstone, wrong part, via/drill, delamination, contamination.
topics.intuition: Engineer lapangan harus bisa bergerak dari symptom → evidence → hypothesis → test → root cause.
design: Bedakan design defect dan process defect.
limitations: Diagnosis remote tanpa measurement/inspection harus diberi confidence rendah.
practice: Buat fault tree board tidak boot.
Bedakan open net, short, wrong value, bad solder.

branches.title: P7. Bring-up, Debug, Validation & Quality
branches.summary: Tahap dari board pertama datang sampai design siap scale: safe power-up, interface debug, compliance, regression, failure tracking.

topics.title: First Power-Up & Bring-up Sequence
topics.summary: Pre-power inspection, resistance checks, current-limited supply, rail sequencing, clocks/reset, programming/debug, interface tests.
topics.intuition: Bring-up yang disiplin mencegah board rusak dan mempercepat root cause.
design: Buat bring-up checklist sebelum board datang.
Log setiap measured value dan anomaly.
limitations: AI tidak boleh menyatakan board aman dipower tanpa kondisi measurement/safety yang memadai.
practice: Buat sequence bring-up MCU board.
Tentukan stop-condition saat current abnormal.

topics.title: Verification, Validation & Compliance Thinking
topics.summary: Pisahkan verification desain terhadap spec dan validation produk terhadap use-case; buat test matrix dan acceptance criteria.
topics.intuition: ‘Berfungsi sekali’ bukan validation.
limitations: Virtual simulation tidak menggantikan required compliance/lab certification.
practice: Buat test matrix power + digital interface + thermal.
Tentukan pass/fail criteria.

topics.title: Yield, Reliability & Design Feedback Loop
topics.summary: Gunakan defect/yield/field data untuk memperbaiki design rules, footprint, placement, testability dan supplier process.
topics.intuition: Professional flow adalah closed loop, bukan design sekali lalu selesai.
design: Masukkan lesson learned kembali ke library/rules.
limitations: Reliability prediction perlu mission profile/material/process data.
practice: Buat Pareto defect hipotetik.
Usulkan corrective/preventive action.

branches.title: P8. EDA Automation, Data Engineering & AI-Assisted Workflow
branches.summary: Bagian yang sangat cocok untuk background Software Engineering: typed domain model, scripting, CI, rule engines, data provenance dan AI agent yang tidak mengarang.

topics.title: Typed ECAD Domain Model & Source of Truth
topics.summary: Represent component, pin, net, footprint, pad, track, via, zone, layer, rule dan release sebagai data terstruktur dengan schema/version.
topics.intuition: Automation profesional butuh data model yang konsisten, bukan DOM scraping/hardcoded UI.
design: Separate view state from engineering state.
limitations: Model yang incomplete harus expose UNKNOWN, bukan isi nilai palsu.
practice: Buat schema net/track/via minimal.
Desain migration v1→v2 tanpa kehilangan data.

topics.title: Python/JS/TCL Automation for Hardware
topics.summary: Automate BOM checks, rule checks, data transforms, test parsing, release packaging, statistics dan CAD workflows.
topics.intuition: Current hardware roles increasingly value scripting untuk mempercepat design/validation.
limitations: Script tidak boleh bypass engineering review untuk safety/production-critical decisions.
practice: Tulis parser BOM→risk report.
Buat CI yang fail pada missing MPN/DRC blocker.

topics.title: AI Engineering Agent with Tools + RAG + Guardrails
topics.summary: Gunakan LLM untuk reasoning, retrieval dan planning; gunakan deterministic tools untuk mutation/checks; tampilkan model/status/coverage.
topics.intuition: LLM bagus untuk reasoning dan bahasa, tetapi engineering state harus ditulis lewat typed commands yang tervalidasi.
design: LLM cannot claim an action executed.
Show provider status and model metadata.
limitations: LLM output bukan measurement/datasheet/manufacturing evidence.
practice: Bedakan query yang cukup local vs butuh LLM.
Desain action preview + atomic rollback.

topics.title: CI/CD for Hardware Data & Release
topics.summary: Gunakan checks, tests, fingerprints, manifests dan release gates seperti software engineering tanpa menyamakan board dengan software semata.
topics.intuition: Hardware release dapat memperoleh disiplin software: reproducible, versioned, reviewable, automated.
design: Release package traceable ke source revision.
limitations: CI tidak menggantikan physical validation.
practice: Buat pipeline schematic→DRC→CAM→manifest.
Definisikan blocker production.

branches.title: P9. Capstone Industri & Career Readiness 2026
branches.summary: Proyek akhir end-to-end yang menghasilkan portfolio setara workflow nyata, bukan sekadar screenshot PCB.

topics.title: Capstone: Requirement → Board → Bring-up → Release
topics.summary: Bangun satu board nyata/realistis melalui requirement, schematic, library, ERC, stackup, placement, routing, DRC, CAM, assembly planning, bring-up/test dan revision.
topics.intuition: Portfolio kuat menunjukkan keputusan, trade-off, evidence dan debugging—bukan hanya board terlihat rapi.
design: Pilih project dengan power + digital interface + sensor/actuator.
Simpan design review notes dan test evidence.
limitations: Tanpa physical fabrication, tandai tahap yang belum divalidasi sebagai virtual/pre-production.
practice: Deliver: requirement, schematic, PCB, DRC report, BOM, CAM draft, test plan, failure log, revision note.
Present 10-minute design review.

topics.title: Career Map: Layout / Hardware / SI-PI / DFM / EDA Automation
topics.summary: Pilih jalur berdasarkan kekuatan: physical layout, circuit/system design, electromagnetic analysis, manufacturing, atau automation.
topics.intuition: Skill overlap tinggi, tetapi portfolio dan depth harus sesuai role target.
limitations: Job posting berubah; gunakan role map sebagai current snapshot, bukan jaminan hiring.
practice: Audit gap skill terhadap satu role.
Buat 12-week learning plan berdasarkan gap.
